navigation.label: Documents
navigation.description: Files attached to this workspace's records.

page.description: Every file this workspace stores, the record it belongs to and the state of its scan.
denied: You need the documents read permission to see this workspace's files.
table.title: Stored documents

search.label: Search documents
empty.title: No documents yet

emptyFiltered.title: No document matches
emptyFiltered.hint: Clear the search or the filters.
loadFailed.title: Could not load the documents
loadFailed.hint: The request failed, so nothing was read. Refresh to try again.
action.downloadRefusedInfected: An infected file is removed the moment the scan finds it, so there is nothing to download.
action.downloadRefusedDeleted: This document was deleted, so there is nothing to download.
action.deleteSelectedRefused: None of the selected rows is a stored document you can delete.
selection.label: Select all documents on screen
delete.title: Delete this document?
delete.description: {name} is removed from storage and its row is kept as the trail. This cannot be undone.
deleteMany.title: Delete the selected documents?
deleteMany.description.one: {count} document is removed from storage and its row is kept as the trail. This cannot be undone.
deleteMany.description.other: {count} documents are removed from storage and their rows are kept as the trail. This cannot be undone.
upload.drawer.title: Upload a document
upload.drawer.subtitle: The file is stored encrypted and attached to the record you name.
upload.form.fileHelp: Up to 25 MB. PDF, images, text, CSV and Office documents.
upload.form.fileHelpLimited: Up to {limit}. PDF, images, text, CSV and Office documents.
upload.form.tooLarge: This file is larger than {limit}, which is all the platform stores.
upload.form.typeRefused: This kind of file is not one the platform stores.
upload.form.ownerModuleHelp: The module that owns the record, for example directory.core.
upload.form.recordRefHelp: The owning module's own reference for the record.
upload.form.descriptionHelp: Optional note shown beside the file.
upload.form.constraint: The declared type is verified against the bytes, and the workspace quota is checked before anything is stored.
details.title: Document
details.subtitle: A stored document and the text read out of it.
text.denied: You need the documents read permission to read this text.
text.pendingHint: The text is being read in the background. This tab checks again every few seconds.
text.empty.title: No text on these pages
text.empty.hint: The document holds no readable text in this range.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_TEXT_FORMAT: Text is not read out of this file type.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_TEXT_UNREADABLE: The file is damaged or does not carry the structure of its type.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_TEXT_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than text extraction reads.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_TEXT_FAILED: Reading the text failed several times and was stopped.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_OCR_UNCONFIGURED: The document has no text layer and this deployment has no OCR service.
text.reason.DOCUMENT_OCR_FAILED: The OCR service could not read the document.
text.error.load: Could not read the text of this document.
text.error.retry: Could not send the document to OCR again.
settings.quotaBytes.label: Storage quota (bytes)
settings.quotaBytes.description: Bytes this workspace may hold in document storage; 0 refuses every upload.
settings.readUrlSeconds.label: Read URL lifetime (seconds)
settings.readUrlSeconds.description: How long a signed download link stays valid after it is issued.
error.load: Could not load the documents of this workspace.
error.readUrl: Could not issue a download link.
error.downloadBlocked: The browser blocked the download tab. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
error.deleteMany: Could not delete the selected documents.
error.code.QUOTA_EXCEEDED: This workspace has no storage left. Delete a document or raise the quota.
error.code.DOCUMENT_TOO_LARGE: The file is larger than the platform object limit.
error.code.CONTENT_TYPE_REFUSED: This platform does not store files of that type.
error.code.CONTENT_MISMATCH: The file does not carry the structure its type claims.
error.code.DOCUMENT_INFECTED: The scanner reported this file as infected. Nothing was stored.
error.code.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND: The document does not exist in this workspace.
error.code.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Document storage is unavailable. Try again shortly.
error.code.CONTENT_TYPE_REQUIRED: The browser did not report the file type. Choose the file again.
error.code.CSRF_REJECTED: The session proof expired. Reload the page and try again.
error.code.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to perform this action.
error.code.TOKEN_MUTATION_DENIED: An API token cannot make this change; sign in and try again.
error.code.CURSOR_INVALID: That page is no longer available. Refresh the list.
error.code.DOCUMENT_TEXT_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only a document without a text layer is read again, and only while OCR is available.
navigation.templatesDescription: Document templates modules ship and the versions this workspace kept.
templates.page.title: Templates
templates.page.description: Templates that render documents for records. Every save keeps a new version, and a rendered document names the version it came from.
templates.denied: You need the templates read permission to see this workspace's document templates.
templates.table.title: Document templates
templates.table.caption: Document templates of this workspace
templates.table.noteManage: A module ships each template. Saving keeps a new version; reverting to the module default is a version too.
templates.table.noteRead: A module ships each template. Owners edit them; you can open a template and preview it.
templates.search.label: Search templates
templates.column.title: Template
templates.version.defaultHint: This workspace still uses the module default; the first render or save keeps it as version 1.
templates.empty.title: No templates yet
templates.empty.hint: A module that ships document templates lists them here.
templates.emptyFiltered.title: No template matches
templates.editor.title: Template
templates.editor.subtitle: A template and its versions.
templates.editor.defaultChanged: The module shipped a new default. This workspace follows the default, so the next render keeps it as a new version.
templates.editor.readOnly: You can preview this template. Editing needs the templates manage permission.
templates.editor.bodyHelp: Markdown with headings 1 to 3, lists, quotes, tables, --- rules and ---pagebreak---. Placeholders are {{ field }}; blocks are {{#each}} and {{#if}} on lines of their own.
templates.editor.layoutHelp: Page size, margins in millimetres, and one line of header and footer. {{page}} and {{pages}} count the pages.
templates.editor.titleHelp: Also the file name; placeholders allowed.
templates.editor.footerHelp: Optional, one line, for example Page {{page}} of {{pages}}.
templates.editor.schemaHelp: The fields the module hands to the template. It belongs to the module and cannot be edited here.
templates.editor.previewHelp: Renders the draft on the sample input. Nothing is saved or stored.
templates.editor.sampleInvalid: The sample input is not valid JSON.
templates.editor.historyHelp: Newest first. Compare a version with the one before it, or restore it as a new version.
templates.editor.historyEmptyHint: The module default is kept as version 1 on the first render or save.
templates.editor.constraint: Saving keeps a new version. A rendered document names the version it came from.
templates.field.title: Title
templates.notice.reverted: The module default was kept as version {version}.
templates.error.previewBlocked: The browser blocked the preview tab. Allow pop-ups for this page and try again.
templates.error.diff: Could not load the versions to compare.
templates.diff.first: Version 1 is the first version; every line is shown as added.
templates.diff.title: Changes from version {previous} to version {version}
templates.diff.bodySame: The body did not change; the layout did.
templates.revert.title: Revert to the module default
templates.revert.description: Keeps the module default as a new version, and later defaults follow it.
templates.revert.confirmDescription: The module default becomes the next version. Earlier versions stay in the history.
templates.restore.confirmDescription: The body and layout of version {version} become the next version. Earlier versions stay in the history.
error.code.TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND: No template is registered under that key.
error.code.TEMPLATE_INVALID: The template has errors. Fix the lines listed and try again.
error.code.TEMPLATE_INPUT_INVALID: The sample input does not match the template's input schema.
error.code.TEMPLATE_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone saved another version first. Reload the template and apply your change again.
error.code.TEMPLATE_UNCHANGED: The template already reads like that, so no version was added.
error.code.TEMPLATE_VALUE_INVALID: A value in the input cannot be printed by its formatter.
error.code.TEMPLATE_ROWS_EXCEEDED: The input repeats more rows than a document holds.
error.code.TEMPLATE_OUTPUT_TOO_LARGE: The document would print more text than a render allows.
error.code.TEMPLATE_PAGES_EXCEEDED: The PDF would run past 200 pages.
error.code.TEMPLATE_VERSION_NOT_FOUND: The template has no such version.
error.code.TEMPLATE_PREVIEW_BUSY: Other previews are rendering right now. Try again in a moment.
